column1: # Shared Go/Rust repo-role golden spec (one source of truth). Format: <path>\t<role>.
# Roles: code | test | doc | guide | config | other (see rust-core symbolgraph.rs repo_role).
# The Rust test (repo_role_matches_golden_spec) asserts repo_role(path)==role for every
# row; the Go test (TestGuidanceRootsMatchGoldenSpec) asserts the Go guidance discovery
# recognizes exactly the `guide` path-roots/filenames here. Keep BOTH in sync via this file.
# --- guidance (path roots, must mirror Go collectWorkspaceGuidance walkRoots) ---
# --- guidance (named files, must mirror Go candidate filenames) ---
